prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Shiomi visual novel BG, shiomi_station_hall__day__bg.
World and location facts: Keiwa year seven, Shiomi is a mature Japanese industrial port city with electric commuter rail, electricity, district steam heating and electromechanical communications. Shiomi Station is a four-storey steel-and-glass station complex. Its public hall has a large mechanical clock, split-flap timetable, staffed ticket windows, enclosed mechanical ticket machines, luggage lockers, public telephones and a small keyboard text terminal. Engines, boilers and signal machinery are in staff-only equipment rooms, never the passenger hall.
Established scene facts: Clear spring afternoon, normal quiet off-peak service, clean maintained working station. No named characters.
Primary request: Generate ONE complete opaque landscape background, horizontal 16:9, as close as possible to 1920x1080 native pixels, never a grid. The hall should read as a credible everyday mature city railway hub.
Style/medium: Polished Japanese visual-novel hand-painted environmental art, precise architectural perspective, fine restrained lines, tangible materials, soft luminous daylight, subtle painterly texture; natural cream, blue-grey steel, muted green and wood accents, no global cyan filter. Establish the visual style for a coherent series.
Composition/framing: Eye-level camera about 1.5m in the middle of a wide public concourse. High central mechanical clock under clear steel roof trusses; split-flap board beyond and above head level. Glass windows on left, ticket facilities at far right and rear edges, lockers and public telephone on side walls. Keep the central 30-70% horizontally at character head and torso heights low in visual density. Entire near floor and central walking aisle unobstructed, suitable sprite foot anchors around x=.35/.65,y=.88. Small distant passenger silhouettes optional, no middle or near people. Normal-scale gates deep in the hall. The clock and main hall remain legible centrally.
Lighting/mood: Bright spring window daylight from upper left, neutral approximately 5200K with softer practical overhead electric light, quiet confident everyday life. Soft realistic floor shadows, no baked character shadows.
Materials/textures: Pale stone floor, painted blue-grey steel members, glazing, practical enclosed cream and green electromechanical ticket cabinets with buttons and paper-ticket slots, maintained wall panels and wooden seating at sides.
Constraints: Perspective and pedestrian paths must work; machinery belongs behind the boundary, roof trusses structural rather than decoration. Signs small and incidental with simple Japanese labels if needed.
Avoid: Brass fantasy decoration, giant exposed gears or steam vents, Victorian outfits, touchscreens, holograms, airships at the rail station, foreground figures, dialogue box, choices, game UI, title, watermark, collage.
